about: Compact record of the measurements behind the DOCCHECK decision of batch 1008 (no new document checker; the Checked-by line and the unparsable-result message). Figures are the design agent's, with the independent audit's confirmations and corrections applied. Source of the full texts: docs/experiments/batch-1008-design-audit-20261008/design-audit.json, entry DOCCHECK. Journal: docs/shiploop-batch-1008a-journal-2026-10-08.md.
end_state: validated another way: the classification was run once on 2026-10-08 and its output is committed here. The classifier script was not kept, so the repository cannot re-run it: a test pins this file's presence and shape, not its figures. The audit re-counted the shell calls and the link-regex scripts by its own method and agreed; it did not re-derive the per-purpose split.
caveats: One run per figure (n=1). The Luna figures are ShipLoop 1.21.0 at xhigh.

Every minute figure is the time from the previous tool result to the script's call, so it includes the model's thinking: it is an upper bound for the cost of the script, not the script's own run time.

The per-purpose split depends on the classifier's precedence rule (loop and backchain glue, then document authoring, then document check); the 8.9 minutes of document checks moves with that rule. The audit's own count of the markdown-link scripts (43, about 15.4 minutes by the same bound, about 4 percent of the window) supports 'no new checker' under any classification.
Run folders are under /Users/dadleet/e2e-runs, outside the repository.
